items.headline: Former Falcons C, 6-time Pro Bowler Jeff Van Note dies at 80
items.description: Jeff Van Note, a six-time Pro Bowl center who spent all 18 seasons of his NFL career with the Falcons and was inducted into the team's Ring of Honor in 2006, has died. He was 80.
